title: Louder Than the Silence (ONE OK ROCK-style arena rock)
style: English, Japanese arena rock in the style of ONE OK ROCK, emotional alternative rock with post-hardcore energy, powerful raspy male tenor lead vocal with soaring belted high notes and heartfelt delivery, driving distorted electric guitars with palm-muted verses and wide open chorus riffs, punchy hard-hitting rock drums, thick bass, cinematic string swells, anthemic stadium chorus with gang vocal whoa-ohs, explosive dynamic build from a restrained verse to a massive chorus, E minor, 4/4, 150 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro - clean guitar arpeggio, then the full band hits]

[Verse - tight drums, palm-muted guitars, restrained male vocal]
Woke up in a city that forgot my name
Same old ceiling, same old rain
They told me stay quiet, learn to play the game
But I was never built that way

[Pre-Chorus - drums open up, guitars build, vocal rising]
Every scar I got, I'm gonna wear it out loud
No more hiding in the crowd
Count it down, three, two, one

[Chorus - full band, soaring belted vocal, gang vocal whoa-ohs, strings]
I'm gonna be louder than the silence
Louder than the voices in my head
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
If the whole world's gonna fall apart tonight
I'll be the one still standing when it's done
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
Louder than the silence

[Verse - driving guitars, half-time drums, urgent vocal]
Kept every letter that I never sent
Every word I never meant
Now I'm burning them like fuel inside my chest
Watch me rise above the rest

[Pre-Chorus - drums open up, guitars build, vocal rising]
Every scar I got, I'm gonna wear it out loud
No more hiding in the crowd
Count it down, three, two, one

[Chorus - full band, soaring belted vocal, gang vocal whoa-ohs, strings]
I'm gonna be louder than the silence
Louder than the voices in my head
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
If the whole world's gonna fall apart tonight
I'll be the one still standing when it's done
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
Louder than the silence

[Bridge - quiet piano and strings, soft vocal, then drums build to a huge drop]
And if I fall, I fall with my eyes wide open
Nothing left unbroken, nothing left unsaid
So let it ring, let it ring, let it ring out
Louder, louder, louder

[Chorus - final, biggest, full strings, gang vocals, highest belted notes]
I'm gonna be louder than the silence
Louder than the voices in my head
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
If the whole world's gonna fall apart tonight
I'll be the one still standing when it's done
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
Louder than the silence

[Outro - band drops out, one solo vocal line, last guitar chord rings out]
Louder than the silence
